licensure.disciplinary_grounds.rationale: These nine buckets capture the dominant clusters in the data: deceptive acts in obtaining or using a license (Fraud or Misrepresentation), poor-quality or careless work (Negligence or Incompetence), walking off jobs or failing to finish (Contract Abandonment or Nonperformance), diverting or failing to pay funds (Financial Misconduct), procedural license/registration rule breaches such as wrong name or acting while suspended (License or Registration Violations), criminal convictions (Criminal Conviction), lapsed bonds or insurance (Insurance or Bond Deficiency), building-code and safety-law violations (Regulatory or Code Violations), and enabling or being an unlicensed operator (Unlicensed Practice or Assistance), together covering every item without leaving a large residual.

profession_specific.voidable_contract_cl.rationale: These buckets reflect the distinct functional categories of voidable clauses seen across states: waivers of statutory/legal rights, releases from liability or harm, confession-of-judgment and jury-trial provisions, payment/wage assignments, code compliance waivers, auto-renewal provisions, and fee-shifting clauses, covering all items without an overloaded catch-all.
